thread:
tess_sales: Heads-up - AuroraHealth wants a Private/VPC POC for our inference stack. They have three hard requirements: preserved L3 source IP for internal logging, mutual TLS to the connector, and minimal CIDR openings. Also asked if static egress IPs change pricing.

jamal_se: TL;DR: mTLS yes. Static egress yes (paid addon). L3 IP preserve only with peering/TGW routing; PrivateLink will NAT to connector ENI. Ask if app-header (X-Forwarded-For) is acceptable as a fallback.

lydia_netops: PrivateLink is easiest for locked-down environments since only outbound allowlist to our ENIs is required. Peering preserves src IP but needs route tables + security group changes and symmetric return path. If they insist on L3 preservation, we'll need their netops to approve routes and SNAT changes.

mark_platform: Pricing note: managed static egress IPs = one-time setup + monthly per-IP fee + small egress surcharge. Dedicated reserved capacity can bundle IPs at a discount. BYO EIP reduces monthly platform fee but requires customer procurement.

ops-bot: infra window 2025-06-15 01:00-03:00 UTC - provisioning may be delayed if requested then.

jamal_se: Minimal firewall checklist for POC (confirm final EIPs with infra):
- Allow outbound TCP 443 to: 52.14.201.12, 52.14.201.13 (sample connector ENIs)
- Allow DNS 53 to their resolver or our private DNS stub
- Allow NTP UDP 123 (cert validation timing)
- Allow ephemeral return ports 1024-65535 if NATted
- Allow ICMP (type 3) for PMTU discovery

lydia_netops: If they use FQDN-based egress allowlisting (Palo Alto/NGFW), we can provide privatelink FQDNs (e.g., aurora.privatelink.redwood.ai) but DNS-based allowlist can be spoofed; IP whitelisting is stronger.

tess_sales: Aurora's compliance says X-Forwarded-For is not enough for audit; they need L3 source for IDS. Can we still do a fast POC?

lydia_netops: Fast path: run PrivateLink with static egress for functional verification this week. Parallel track: start peering design for L3 preservation (1-2 business days review) and schedule infra changes. POC timeline stays tight but feasible.

jamal_se: Test curl snippets: mTLS check:
```bash
curl --cert test-client.crt --key test-client.key -v https://aurora.privatelink.redwood.ai:443/healthz
```
non-mTLS:
```bash
curl -v https://aurora.privatelink.redwood.ai:443/healthz
```

Include note: if using peering with L3 preserve, make sure their SNAT is disabled towards connector subnets.

mark_platform: I'll email a pricing delta (static egress vs included in reserved bundle) in ~2 hours.

tess_sales: Action items: 1) Lydia to share test EIPs + allowlist by EOD, 2) Jamal to prepare mTLS test certs and scripts, 3) Mark to send pricing delta. I'll loop in aurora-netops once EIPs available.

lydia_netops: Will send EIPs by EOD. Need point of contact at Aurora (name + firewall engineer).

tess_sales: POC contact: nina.ops@aurorahealth.com. Thanks all :rocket:
